instruction: Cinematic film still, medium shot, eye-level side profile view. Inside a modern office next to a large window overlooking a city street, the man in the grey patterned blazer (R2) stands on the left, facing right, shaking hands with the man in the light blue sweater (R1), who stands on the right facing left. They clasp right hands in a firm handshake. The man in the light blue sweater (R1) keeps his left hand in his pants pocket. Soft, cool daylight from the window illuminates the scene with an overcast, professional mood.
